_about: Template build.js functions this site customises on purpose. Checked by cronologia/core tools/build-drift.py: an undeclared difference is drift; when the template's version of a declared function changes, the declaration goes STALE until the change is ported here and `base` is bumped (python3 tools/build-drift.py --hash <name>).

seoHead.reason: a jsonLdType option, so the prayer subpages can declare their own schema.org type

langSwitcher.reason: links climb by route depth (upTo), so the switcher works on the subpages

renderReference.reason: an explicitValue option: a subpage lists only the sources it cites, numbered with their site-wide numbers

renderPage.reason: stylesheet and river.js paths by route depth; links to the declared subpages at the end of the nav

main.reason: writes the subpages (the `pages` key: chaplet, novena) for each locale and adds their routes to the sitemap

data-invariants.test.js.reason: lagrimas publishes the chaplet and novena subpages; its sitemap check includes their routes
